components.name: Departure Board Row
components.description: A form field as a train departure: time, field name, verified value, status box.
components.html: 12:04Emailada@example.com
components.css: .ds-board { border: 1px solid rgba(23,20,14,0.32); background: #e9e5d8; font-family: 'Archivo', sans-serif; } .ds-board-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 60px 1fr 1.3fr 42px; gap: 12px; align-items: center; padding: 11px 16px; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(23,20,14,0.14); } .ds-time { font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace; font-size: 12px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: #17140e; } .ds-svc { font-size: 13.5px; font-weight: 600; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; } .ds-dest { font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace; font-size: 11.5px; color: #575146; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; } .ds-st { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 21px; height: 21px; border: 1px solid rgba(23,20,14,0.32); border-radius: 3px; color: #17140e; } @media (max-width: 640px) { .ds-board-row { grid-template-columns: 40px 1fr 30px; grid-template-areas: "time svc st" "time dest st"; row-gap: 2px; } }

components.name: Navigation Masthead
components.description: Sticky paper masthead with mono uppercase links and a scaling ink underline.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; gap: 30px; font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace; font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #575146; } .ds-nav-link { position: relative; cursor: pointer; transition: color 0.18s cubic-bezier(0.22,0.8,0.2,1); } .ds-nav-link::after { content: ""; position: absolute; left: 0; bottom: -5px; width: 100%; height: 1px; background: #17140e; transform: scaleX(0); transform-origin: left; transition: transform 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.22,0.8,0.2,1); } .ds-nav-link:hover { color: #17140e; } .ds-nav-link:hover::after { transform: scaleX(1); }

narrative.overview: Veya presents the job application as a scheduled journey — a warm-paper Swiss departure board where every field is a service leaving the station on time, verified and on its way. The system is strictly monochrome: warm paper and warm ink, hairline rules, tabular data. It is the visual language of trust through precision: nothing glows, nothing shouts, everything is on time and nothing leaves the machine. Density is calm and editorial: large grotesque display with a serif-italic counterpoint, tabular mono data set in ruled grids, and generous paper. Depth comes from tonal layering and a single soft shadow under the hero board, never from neon or glow. Motion is one authored moment — the live departure board ticking — with everything else still.
keyCharacteristics: Warm monochrome only — paper and ink ramps, never gray, never hue.
Hairline rules (1px) define structure; borders are lines, not boxes.
One display voice (Archivo) with an Instrument Serif italic counterpoint for the emotive phrase.
Tabular IBM Plex Mono reserved for data, times, labels, and line designations.
Sharp corners (2–3px); no pill shapes, no soft rounded rectangles.
One authored motion moment: the live departure board.

rules.name: The Monochrome Rule
rules.body: Warm paper and ink only. Any departure from the ramp (a hue, a glow, a pure gray) is a defect, not an accent. Status is communicated by fill vs. outline (solid = verified, dashed = draft), never by color.

rules.name: The Inverted Moment Rule
rules.body: The ink panel is used exactly once, for privacy — the page's single moment of gravity. Everything else lives on paper.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Archivo carries every word of information; the serif italic appears only in the emotive phrase of a display heading. A second information voice is not available.

rules.name: The Data Voice Rule
rules.body: Times, values, statuses, and labels are set in IBM Plex Mono with tabular numerals. Mono never types a headline and a headline is never set in mono.

rules.name: The Single Shadow Rule
rules.body: The board is the only object that casts a shadow. Depth everywhere else is tonal.

dos: Do stay within the warm paper/ink ramp; tint secondary text from ink, never gray.
Do set times, values, and labels in IBM Plex Mono with tabular numerals.
Do use drawn SVG glyphs (one stroke weight) for every icon and status mark.
Do keep the board the only shadowed object and the ink panel the only inversion.
Do hide the board's live behavior under prefers-reduced-motion.
donts: Don't introduce an accent color, gradient text, glow, or glass. The monochrome is the brand.
Don't use unicode glyphs or emoji as icons.
Don't use mono as a headline voice, or a serif for information.
Don't render small tertiary text on raised or deep paper (fails contrast); keep it on paper or step it up to secondary ink.
Don't add cards, rounded rectangles, or pill shapes — structure is ruled lines and near-square corners.
